reason: The C-centered monoclinic cell is strongly supported, but the exact submitted Cc structure is not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the claimed 0.9938 agreement is an extracted-reflection intensity cosine from a 24-coordinate direct-space fit rather than an independently refined full-profile residual. The trace produced several materially different, chemically admissible Cc minima and did not resolve them through explicit comparison or submit alternatives. Z is also not independently established: the Z=4 model has a low calculated density of about 3.45 g/cm3, while plausible higher-Z and other low-symmetry frameworks were not exhaustively instantiated. Thus the symmetry, coordinates, and element ordering remain underdetermined despite good support for the cell and average scattering framework, and another solution attempt is warranted.
